name: glm53_mtp_mapper
purpose: Let the GLM-5.3 MTP drafter (Glm5NextMTP) claim quantization targets written in the checkpoint namespace (model.language_model.layers.45.*), by giving the class the hf_to_vllm_mapper vLLM uses to translate a quantization config.
base_image_note: eugr/spark-vllm@sha256:0afec8d4f79f44685a1ddf758659d33aef3b0f3ec9068e5a7cd1108d30e5581c with libnccl 2.31.2 replaced by 2.30.7; the image the routed Tessera E2M1_K2 cells name. Its MLA sparse-attention sources are stock, which Tessera's GLM53 NoPE backend requires.
derived_image_note: The digest is the OCI image index digest; the 192.168.1.107 name is the pullable copy (plain HTTP, port 80). The localhost name resolves on both Sparks and is the name a Tessera runtime cell uses: sparky (containerd image store) reports the digest as the image Id; sparklina (overlay2) holds it as a RepoDigest over config sha256:9e6882df27dd5274bcb8fe048a0c435c531bbd794247cfc964556cf7d60fbc7d.

build.contents: One Python source edit; no compile, no new wheels, no vendored serving runtime.
build.self_check: The patch refuses an mtp.py whose sha256 is not the base's; the Dockerfile's final RUN imports Glm5NextMTP, asserts the mapper sends model.language_model.layers.45.mlp.experts to model.layers.45.mlp.experts, and asserts the four MLA sources still hash to the stock values.

edits.what: from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import maybe_prefix -> import WeightsMapper, maybe_prefix
Glm5NextMTP.hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(orig_to_new_prefix={'model.language_model.': 'model.'}); load_weights keeps its own strip and is not touched

checks_passed: Dockerfile self-check: the mapper translates the layer-45 expert target; the four MLA sources hash to the stock values
the four MLA hashes and the patched mtp.py hash read identically inside the image on sparky and on sparklina (2026-09-25)
not_qualified: No model has been served on the derived image yet. The first serve is the GLM-5.3-Flash stub route census; this block is updated from it.
The drafter claiming a Tessera- or compressed-tensors-quantized layer 45 has not been exercised; the MTP A/B that would show it is separate work (#1271).

The side effect -- the target model seeing layer-45 targets and the drafter seeing layer 0-44 targets that match none of their modules -- is expected to be ignored (Tessera looks targets up by prefix) but is not yet observed.
